answer: The lagoon check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Activation requires a fresh proof of work that cannot be reused, shared, or parallelised, tied to the epoch so last week's grind buys nothing today. Cross the mirror and the cost lands per identity: cloning a thousand agents means solving a thousand puzzles, which turns a cheap script into an expensive compute bill. Through the nebula, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
